messages:
Anya: Quick idea — can we try an 'after-action velocity' tracker for postmortem follow-ups? Our current followups keep sliding. I sketched a lightweight template and a short pilot (2 weeks) to measure closure velocity. Thoughts?
Sam: +1 on measuring velocity. we need a minimal surface area tho — don't want another spreadsheet. :thumbsup:
Jordan: yes please share the template. also curious how this ties to IC rotation — last time handoffs blurred ownership.
Anya: pasted template below (very small):
```
- action_id: PM-001
- owner: @Sam
- due_date: 2026-04-08
- priority: P2 (customer-impact)
- status: open / blocked / done
- verification: e2e test + runbook update
- recurrence_flag: true/false (did this cause or result from a recurring pattern)
- ticket: https://rwd/jira/PM-123
- notes: short note / blocker
```
Lee: I like recurrence_flag — helps spot repeating patterns. Can we add a quick "validation window" field (how we'll validate the fix, e.g., 7d error rate)
Maria: +1 to validation window. Also propose a weekly 15min "closure huddle" (Mon 11am) for owners to sync blockers. Keeps async backlog small.
Sam: Agree with huddle. For tooling: we can add a saved JQL for overdue followups, and push a digest to #eng-oncall every Monday. e.g., `project = PM AND status != Done AND due_date < now()`
Jordan: Suggestion on roles: Incident Commander owns coordination during incident, but postmortem owner != IC by default. We should have explicit "remediation owner" assigned in the doc. Avoids that blur.
Anya: yep — propose policy: remediation owner must be named in first 72h after postmortem publish or item is auto-escalated to oncall lead.
Sam: automation idea: incident-bot can create followup tasks when postmortem is closed and tag owners from the postmortem draft. low lift.
incident-bot: Reminder: There are 3 open followups older than 14 days — https://rwd/incidents/followups
Lee: For metrics, let's track: closure_velocity (actions_closed / week), median_time_to_close, recurrence_rate (percent of followups flagged recurrence). Two-week pilot to compare before/after.
Anya: Operational checklist for pilot: 1) use template for new postmortems 2) create JQL & bot digest 3) weekly 15m huddle 4) export metrics at 2 weeks. Who owns the pilot?
Sam: I can own the automation (JQL + digest + bot).
Jordan: I'll own metrics + dashboard.
Maria: I'll schedule the weekly huddle and be point for bookings.
Anya: OK — Sam, Jordan, Maria assigned. I'll be backup and do the 72h escalation rule. Let's start Monday 2026-04-06 and run 2 weeks. :rocket:
Sam: acked. I'll post the JQL and bot config in a follow-up message tomorrow.
Jordan: I'll stub the dashboard and share a link by EOD Fri.
Maria: booked Mon 11am for the next two weeks — calendar invite sent.
Anya: thanks all. small ask to everyone: when you create/claim an action, add a 1-line validation criterion (how you'll prove it's fixed). makes closure subjective => objective.
Sam: noted.
Lee: also, add a "relationship" tag if the action maps to an SLO or billing impact. helps prioritize.
Anya: good call. I'll update the template and post final in #eng-oncall. Pilot retrospective 2026-04-20.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Maria: :white_check_mark:
Jordan: looks good — excited to see closure velocity improve.
Anya: closing thread — will open a new thread with final template + links when updated.
